title: Primary Care Engagement Notice — Extra RideLink Trips Carried for Primary Care Visits
content:
Members who keep up with primary care may carry more unused Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips into the next benefit year.

**Rule.** A member who keeps up with primary care may carry more: at least the engaged visit count of 3 primary care visits in the last twelve months adds the engaged cap bonus of 2 to the most trips carried; one or more visits but fewer than 3 adds the seen cap bonus of 1; and no visit adds nothing.

The visits counted are the visits recorded under the member's Primary Care Provider Assignment with a visit date in the last twelve months.

## Visit bands

| Primary care visits in the last twelve months | Added to the most trips carried |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 |
| 1 or 2 | 1 |
| None | Nothing |

## Questions the notice answers

- **Does a visit thirteen months ago count?** No; only visits in the last twelve months count.
- *Hypothetical:* **a member whose most trips carried would be 3, with 4 primary care visits in the last twelve months — what is the most carried?** 3 plus 2, that is 5.
- *Hypothetical:* **the same member with 2 visits?** 3 plus 1, that is 4.
